summary: Frontend testing of B2B CRM (Gewürzberg GmbH) new features completed successfully. All requested features verified: Dashboard Calendar widget, clickable stat cards, Specifications PDF upload zone, no Add Specification button, and Recipes email button.
passed_tests: Dashboard - Calendar widget visible with month view (March 2026) - SUCCESS
Dashboard - Calendar card has data-testid='calendar-card' - SUCCESS
Dashboard - React Day Picker calendar component rendered - SUCCESS
Dashboard - 4 stat cards visible (Total Leads, Orders, Revenue, Emails Sent) - SUCCESS
Dashboard - Stat card click navigates to respective pages (/leads) - SUCCESS
Specifications - Page loads with data-testid='specifications-page' - SUCCESS
Specifications - PDF upload zone visible with 'Upload PDF Specifications' header - SUCCESS
Specifications - 'Drag and drop PDF files' text visible - SUCCESS
Specifications - PDF file input (accept='.pdf') present - SUCCESS
Specifications - NO 'Add Specification' button (as expected per requirements) - SUCCESS
Recipes - Page loads with data-testid='recipes-page' - SUCCESS
Recipes - Email buttons (title='Email Gönder') visible on all recipe cards - SUCCESS
Recipes - Add Recipe button (data-testid='add-recipe-btn') visible - SUCCESS
